aiResearchSummary.text: Ma’aden is researching process innovations in mining and fertilizers. Use of sulfur as alternative carbon-free fuel in an ammonia primary reformer explores sulfur combustion integrated with sulfuric acid co-production. Polluted CO2 capturing with lime produced from phosphogypsum calcination using sulfur targets CO2 sequestration and waste conversion. Integrated process to upgrade low-grade calcareous phosphate ore with low CO2 focuses on higher P2O5 recovery, decarbonization and reduced phosphogypsum, covering fuel substitution, emissions capture and ore beneficiation.
